permission: none (any authenticated user reading their own record)
why: There is no profile-read endpoint on the backend today. AuthResponse (signup/login) only returns { accessToken, tokenType, expiresInSeconds, userId, businessId } - no name/email/phone. The frontend currently caches what the signup form itself submitted (apps/web/src/server/dev-store.ts saveProfile/getProfile) as a stopgap.
